newsitem.title: USA: Judge picks Walder to report on Prudential lawyer.
newsitem.headline: Judge picks Walder to report on Prudential lawyer.

text.p: Federal Judge Alfred Wolin Tuesday ordered the appointment of a neutral examiner, attorney Justin Walder, to investigate allegations of document shredding by Michael Barr.

Barr, a partner in the Chicago-based law firm Sonnenschein Nath & Rosenthal, is also accused of withholding documents from the Florida Attorney General's office, which is looking into massive fraud allegations against the Prudential Insurance Co of America.
The Sonnenschein firm is Prudential's top outside counsel defending the company against numerous charges that its agents defrauded life insurance customers for years.
In his ruling, Judge Wolin appointed Walder, an attorney, and formerly a deputy attorney general of New Jersey as well as an assistant prosecutor in Essex County there, as the neutral examiner.
Walder must report his findings back to the court by January 27.
